title: Monitor check-name preservation in Command Center
description: Run check-pr-monitor-roundtrip.mts setup first. Supply ROUNDTRIP_TAG/PR_URL/GW_URL and the resulting monitor_id. The unavailable validation account cannot start work.

navigate.intent: The desktop monitor editor uses the shared subscription record.

panel.intent: Monitoring controls are available independently of PR discovery.

tab.intent: The operator can configure the validation subscription.

edit.intent: Load the exact saved monitor including its comma-bearing check name.

limits.intent: Monitoring interval and check filters are editable in one form.

interval.intent: Change polling frequency without changing watched-check identities.

save.intent: Save the real monitor configuration through the gateway.

saved.intent: The updated monitor returns to the inventory.

verify.intent: A gateway read proves whole check names were preserved while the interval changed.

monitor-loaded.intent: The requested subscription has arrived from the gateway before editing.

select-monitor.intent: Select this PR in the unified list to open its monitoring controls.
